mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reply (user_id, board_id, parent_reply_id, content, depth, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{boardId}, #{parentReplyId}, #{content}, #{depth}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT reply_id, u.user_id, board_id, u.nickname, parent_reply_id, u.profile_url, r.content, r.created_at, r.updated_at, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, r.created_at, NOW()) < 60 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, r.created_at, NOW()), '초 전') WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, r.created_at, NOW()) < 60 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, r.created_at, NOW()), '분 전') WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, r.created_at, NOW()) < 24 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, r.created_at, NOW()), '시간 전') ELSE CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, r.created_at, NOW()), '일 전') END AS date_ago FROM reply r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE parent_reply_id IS NULL AND depth = 0 AND board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT reply_id, u.user_id, board_id, u.nickname, parent_reply_id, u.profile_url, r.content, r.created_at, r.updated_at, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, r.created_at, NOW()) < 60 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, r.created_at, NOW()), '초 전') WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, r.created_at, NOW()) < 60 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, r.created_at, NOW()), '분 전') WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, r.created_at, NOW()) < 24 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, r.created_at, NOW()), '시간 전') ELSE CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, r.created_at, NOW()), '일 전') END AS date_ago FROM reply r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE parent_reply_id IS NOT NULL AND depth != 0 AND board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
